name: QRFLOW.codes
description: Lets an AI assistant create dynamic QR codes that can change after printing
author: nativecodeapps

tools.name: list_code_kinds
tools.description: Every kind of QR code QRFLOW can make, the fields each one needs and the plan it requires.

tools.name: list_qr_codes
tools.description: List the account's QR codes, newest first, with scan counts and the printed short link.

tools.name: get_qr_code
tools.description: One QR code by id: what it opens, whether it is dynamic, its short link, scans and image.

tools.name: create_qr_code
tools.description: Create a QR code of any kind and return its printed short link and image.

tools.name: update_qr_code
tools.description: Re-point a printed dynamic code, or change its label, link name, colors, pause or expiry.

tools.name: delete_qr_code
tools.description: Delete a QR code and its scan history for good.

tools.name: get_scan_stats
tools.description: Scan analytics for one code by day, device, country, city, browser, operating system or referrer.

tools.name: bulk_create_qr_codes
tools.description: Create many dynamic codes at once from a list of destinations.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: The account's connected link domains, which one is the default, and their ids.

tools.name: get_qr_image
tools.description: Return the QR code image inline, plus signed 24 hour PNG and SVG download links.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Who is signed in, their plan, and the limits that apply.
